description: Defines an exception class `GLClosureNotFoundException` that is thrown when a GL account closure resource is not found; it extends a base exception class and provides constructors for messaging and exception chaining.

classes.name: GLClosureNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating that a GL account closure resource was not found, extending a generic resource not found exception.

methods.name: GLClosureNotFoundException(Long id)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception for a missing GL closure resource, with a message including the invalid id.

methods.name: GLClosureNotFoundException(Long id, EmptyResultDataAccessException e)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception with an underlying cause, useful for exception chaining.
